titleEn: I Do Not Know the Ending

pages.text: In winter, the sun set early. With long nights, the three gathered by the shop window.
Nono wanted to sing the whole winter song. Grandpa Badger taught it one line at a time.
Nono quickly learned the start. Excited, he bounced.
Thick snow fell outside. Nono fluttered to the windowsill.
He watched only the snow. Behind him, the song continued.
The next evening, the three sang. Nono knew only the beginning.
In the middle, his voice stopped. Only his beak opened and closed.
Grandpa Badger said, "The last line of this song is the prettiest."
Nono hopped beside Grandpa. Line by line, he sang along to the end.
That night, the three sang from beginning to end. White mist clouded the window.
